summary: The deploy menu's and the two orders windows' tooltips, read whole.

addresses.name: CSideMenuDeploy::OwnsElement
addresses.comment: Slot 6: whether an element is the deploy menu's - yes only where an entry of `deployment_queue` claims it through its observer slot 22. The in-game screen asks it of the open side menu before slot 8. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-orderstooltips.md.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 4`; the walk of `deployment_queue`'s entries and their +0x1C table's +0x58.

addresses.name: CSideMenuDeploy::GetTooltip
addresses.signature: GuiTooltipText* __thiscall CSideMenuDeploy::GetTooltip(CSideMenuDeploy* this, GuiTooltipText* out, CGuiObject* element)
addresses.comment: Slot 8: the tooltip of the entry that claims the element - a target's line (0x826200) while choosing_target (+0x58), else a finished unit's line (0x826CA0); empty where none claims it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-orderstooltips.md.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 8`; the two calls with the entry in edx at 0x828756.

addresses.name: CDeploymentEntry_Tooltip
addresses.comment: A finished unit's line in the deploy menu: the deployment by its id (+0x78); where it is a unit's (slot 8 answering 0x4B4) and that unit is a land unit (slot 15), for each brigade `£` + its type's key + ` ` + its name + `\n`. Otherwise empty. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-orderstooltips.md.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 4`; the join's operands are given by the decompilation.

addresses.name: CDeploymentTargetEntry_Tooltip
addresses.comment: A target's line in the deploy menu: the unit at +0xA0, for each brigade `£` + its type's key + ` ` + its name + `\n`, whatever the unit is. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-orderstooltips.md.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 4`; the join's operands are given by the decompilation.

addresses.name: CSideMenu::IsShown
addresses.comment: Slot 4: whether the side menu's window (+0x24) is shown, its byte +0x5B. The in-game screen asks it of the open side menu before slots 6 and 8. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-orderstooltips.md.

addresses.name: CNavalOrdersView::GetTooltip
addresses.signature: void* __thiscall CNavalOrdersView::GetTooltip(CNavalOrdersView* this, void* out, void* element)
addresses.comment: Slot 6, read whole. `accept` while switched off (slot 48): OV_NO_VALID_ORDER with no order (+0x220), else OV_OUT_OF_RANGE where its slot 8 says no - a key with no text, and not reached since accept is on whenever a row is ticked. stance_label, stance_value and the two stance buttons: OV_STANCE. priority_label and priority_value: OV_PRIO - the priority buttons say nothing, the routine asking twice for `priority_stance_button`. A row of orders_list: its order's description in text and, out of range, OUT_OF_RANGE in delayed with MYRANGE the unit's definition's (+0xC8) range (+0x148) over 1000.0 to one place and RANGE the naval distance from the window's province to the unit's base, trimmed. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-orderstooltips.md.
addresses.revises: Read whole, inferred to confirmed; the priority buttons' silence, which half each text goes in, and the two figures.
addresses.evidence: 0x73FA24 and 0x73FA3F both load 0x15D7088 'priority_stance_button'; the description stored at [esp+0xA0] and OUT_OF_RANGE at [esp+0xBC] (0x73FBD3, 0x73FE39); MYRANGE at 0x73FCC6..0x73FCF3, RANGE at 0x73FD76..0x73FDAD.

addresses.name: CAirOrdersView::GetTooltip
addresses.signature: void* __thiscall CAirOrdersView::GetTooltip(CAirOrdersView* this, void* out, void* element)
addresses.comment: Slot 6, read whole, all in text. daytime_title, daytime_icon and daytime_icondesc: ORDER_DAY_TIME_DESC with PROV the window's province (+0x30) and TIME ORDER_NIGHT or ORDER_DAY by IsNight for it at the start widget's hour and month. accept while switched off: OV_NO_VALID_ORDER with no order (+0x2EC), OV_NO_VALID_PROVINCES with an empty list. The stance's four: OV_STANCE. priority_label and priority_value: OV_PRIO, the buttons nothing. continous_checkbox: OV_CONT. The four shape buttons: AirOrdersBtn_Point, _Region, _Circle, _Conic. A row: its order's description, no range line. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-orderstooltips.md.
addresses.revises: Read whole, inferred to confirmed; which elements give the day readout, and that accept speaks only while switched off.
addresses.evidence: 0x745758..0x7457D9 the three daytime names jumping to 0x745FDE; 0x746050 IsNight with the province in edi; 0x745A83 and 0x745A9E both 'priority_stance_button'.
